items.title: Circle Up
items.note: Today is spacing. Four on one side, one away. Corner first.

items.title: Game Warmup
items.note: Dynamic warmup into partner passing and full speed layups.

items.title: Syracuse
items.note: Set 3 and Set 4, team vs team for points.

items.title: Overload walkthrough
items.note: Nobody moves. Ball goes wing, corner, short corner, high post, skip. Watch the zone slide.

items.title: Split stations: shooting
items.note: Overload spots only: wing, corner, short corner, high post.

items.note: 1-2-2, middle ball screen, 1 and 3 relocate, drive the paint, two on one on the weak side.

focus: Game Ready: Closeouts, Shooting and Pack Line Shell
tagline: Force middle. Close out short. Talk on every pass.

items.title: Circle Up
items.note: We scrimmage at 5:00, so tonight is about being game ready. Two things changed from September, say them out loud: one pass away we do NOT deny anymore, we sit in the gap. On the ball we force him MIDDLE, never baseline. Two non-negotiables: you move on the flight of the pass, and you talk every possession. Split Team 1 / Team 2 for the tally.

visual.coach: Head coach in the center of the circle. Say the scrimmage plan and the two changes out loud. Assistants set out cones for the pack line during warmup.

items.title: Game Warmup
items.note: Dynamic warmup only, baseline to half court and back: jog, high knees, butt kicks, carioca both ways, walking lunge with a twist, leg swings, defensive slides, then two build-up sprints. Captains lead it and call each move. This gets the legs ready for 5:00.

visual.coach: Sideline at half court. Captains run it. Coaches watch for effort and get the cones out on the pack line.

items.title: Pack Line Shell: Stage 1 to 2
items.note: 2 minutes on the board, 12 on the floor. Pack line is 16 feet from the rim. BALL shades baseline and forces middle. GAP sits on the line between his man and the ball. HELP has feet in the lane. 5 on 5, coaches fill in on offense. Stage 1, 5 minutes: no dribble, two count on every catch, defense jumps on the flight of the pass. Freeze after any pass: every defender on his spot is 1 point, anyone late and the group runs a down and back. Stage 2, 7 minutes: game speed, defense calls Ball and Help on every pass or the rep does not count.

visual.coach: Assistants play offense in the left wing and right corner (A, B). Head coach stands above the left slot where he can see all five defenders: yell freeze after a pass, ask one guy his job, award the points.

items.title: Vegas Closeouts
items.note: Defender starts in help with the ball, passes to the wing and closes out: sprint the first two-thirds, short chop steps, get low, two hands up. Shade him baseline so he has to go middle into the help. Offense gets 2 dribbles. Drive goes baseline and the defense loses the rep. Games to 3, winner runs the Victory Lap.

visual.coach: Assistant stands in the gap (Gap) as the help, so the drive middle runs into him. Head coach watches the last three steps: chop, low, two hands up, top foot high.

items.title: Closeout Shooting
items.note: Pairs at both baskets. Partner passes from under the rim and Vegas closes out. Shooter reads it: short closeout, shoot it. Hard closeout, one dribble middle into a pull up. 5 shots, then switch. A 3 counts 2, a pull up counts 1. Top pair runs the Victory Lap. Game shots at game speed.

visual.coach: Head coach at the top of the key between both pairs: call out bad closeouts (flying by, hands down) and keep the pair scores. Assistants rebound and run the far basket pairs.

items.title: Kentucky Shooting
items.note: 3 lines of 3, middle up and half court. Pass, catch, shoot at game speed. Feet set before the catch. Every make, the line calls it out. This is our last shooting before tip.

visual.label: Three lines at half court. Wings fill, middle drives up.
visual.coach: Head coach on the sideline calling the rotation. Assistant under the rim rebounding and feeding the ball back out.

items.title: Pressure Free Throws
items.note: Everyone shoots 2, team says the shooter's name before every attempt. Round 1 any miss and the whole team runs a down and back together. Round 2 Earn Your Lap: make both and run the Victory Lap. Count the tally and name the day's champion. Then the scrimmage plan: I grade three things, force middle, move on the pass, talk. We count turnovers and baseline drives. Break the huddle at 5:00.

visual.coach: Head coach off the lane with the tally. Count it out loud, then give the three things we grade in the scrimmage and break the huddle at 5:00. Assistants grab the stat sheet for the four numbers.

extras.title: Rim War
extras.note: 1v1 finishing from the block, winner stays on, first to 3 runs the Victory Lap.

extras.title: Full Court Layup Competition
extras.note: 2 minutes if we finish early. Drive layups then a 3 pointer, team score. Beat the team record and everyone runs the Victory Lap together.

focus: Pack Line Shell: Help and Recover
tagline: Help stops the drive. Recover on the kick. Cut after you pass.

items.title: Circle Up
items.note: Three things before we start. Captains: I am picking captains this week. I am looking for who talks, who works when nobody is watching, and who shows up every day. Write down two names, not yourself, and hand them to me after practice. I make the final call and announce them Thursday. Union: the Union college teams are here next week. Who is interested? Raise your hand and I will get you the details. Practice: we have 8. One guy missing means nobody gets 4v4, and every practice builds on the last one. Today builds on Sunday. If you cannot be here, tell me before, not after. Then today: Sunday was Ball, Gap, Help. Today the ball moves and we help and recover. Two non-negotiables: move on the flight of the pass, and talk every possession. Winners run is on. Split Team 1 / Team 2. Station groups today: Shooters and Fundamentals.

visual.coach: Head coach in the middle: captains, Union next week (count the hands), why practice matters, then the focus. Assistants hand out scrap paper and pencils for the captain votes and set the cones.

items.title: Game Warmup
items.note: Dynamic warmup only, baseline to half court and back. Jog, high knees, butt kicks, carioca both ways, walking lunge with a twist, leg swings, defensive slides, two build-up sprints. Two guys I pick lead it and call each move. Captains take it over once we name them.

visual.coach: Two players I pick run it. Head coach on the sideline watching effort. Assistants finish the cones and grab the pads for stations.

items.title: Teach: Pack Line Shell Stages 2 and 3
items.note: 2 minutes on the board, 10 on the floor. Stage 2: ball moves, defense jumps to Ball, Gap, Help on the flight of every pass. Stage 3: offense drives middle. Help steps up and stops him, everyone sinks one spot. On the kick out, help sprints back and closes out short. Walk it first, then speed. I yell freeze and ask one guy his job. Late rotation, group runs a down and back.

visual.label: Drive middle, gap helps, kick out, gap recovers.
visual.coach: Assistant B fills the right corner on offense. Assistant A at the board for the first 2 minutes, then sits a wing when we need a fifth. Head coach above the top of the key: freeze, ask, grade the rotation.

items.title: Skill Stations, Round 1
items.note: Two groups today: Shooters at the main basket, Fundamentals at the far basket. Shooters: Read the Screen Shooting. The chair is the screen. Passer calls POP, CURL or FADE and the shooter reads it. 3s count 2. Fundamentals: Ball handling series and Alford Layups. Two-ball pounds, crossover, in and out, then finish with both hands. Eyes up, no looking at the ball. Horn at the end, stay at your basket.

visual.label: Right: Shooters, chair screen. Left: Fundamentals, ball handling into Alford layups.
visual.coach: Assistant B with the Shooters: feed the passer and keep the shot count. Assistant A with Fundamentals: call out eyes down and weak-hand finishes. Head coach floats, more time with Fundamentals.

items.title: Skill Stations, Round 2
items.note: Same groups, new drill. Shooters: Closeout Shooting. Partner passes from under the rim and closes out. Short closeout, shoot it. Hard closeout, one dribble middle into a pull up. A 3 counts 2, a pull up counts 1. Top pair runs the Victory Lap. Fundamentals: Footwork Shooting and USA Pivots. Jump stop, pivot, rip through, shoot. Last 3 minutes add a closeout. Strong pivots keep the ball safe.

visual.label: Right: Shooters, closeout shooting. Left: Fundamentals, jump stop and pivot.
visual.coach: Assistant B keeps the pair scores and calls bad closeouts. Assistant A passes to the Fundamentals group and checks the jump stop and pivot foot. Head coach floats.

items.title: Oregon Passing
items.note: Ball security. Good passes and talk. Call the name before you pass. 2-minute rounds, as many as we can, beat the last round. Bad pass or silent pass is a redo.

visual.label: Full court passing lines, finish at the rim.
visual.coach: Head coach on the sideline counting rounds out loud. Assistants call out any pass that is late or lands at the feet.

items.title: Closeout and Recover
items.note: 5 minutes 1v1 closeouts from help, 2 dribbles, games to 3. Then 5 minutes 2v2 help and recover: the helper stops the drive, then gets back to his man. Open kick-out 3 counts and the defense runs. Talk first or the stop does not count.

visual.label: 2v2: help stops the drive, recovers on the kick.
visual.coach: Head coach watches the helper: feet in the lane, then a short closeout. Assistant A under the rim rebounds and keeps the score.

items.title: Offense Reps: 5v0 to 3v3
items.note: 5 Out Pass and Cut. Three rules: pass and cut, fill the open spot, drive if nobody is open. 4 minutes 5v0: 10 passes with a cut and fill, no dribble. Then 7 minutes 3v3 at both baskets: layup off a cut is 2, a pass with no cut is a turnover. Defense plays pack line.

visual.label: Pass, cut to the rim, everyone fills.
visual.coach: Head coach at half court: yell stop, whoever is standing still says where he should be. Assistant A runs the far basket 3v3 and keeps the score.

items.title: Game 4v4
items.note: Team 1 vs Team 2, games to 7. Option A, Man Only: a talked stop is 2, a paint touch before the shot is worth 1 extra, a pass with no cut is a turnover. Winners run the Victory Lap. Option B, scrimmage graded on three things: help stops the drive, help recovers on the kick, and we cut after we pass.

visual.label: 4v4 with 8. Pack line on defense.
visual.coach: Head coach on the sideline keeping score and calling the grades out loud. Assistant A on the other sideline counts turnovers and baseline drives.

items.title: Pressure Free Throws
items.note: Everyone shoots 2, team says the shooter's name. Round 1: any miss, the whole team runs. Round 2, Earn Your Lap: make both and run the Victory Lap. Count the tally, champion picks the next Circle Up question. Reminder: captain votes to me before you leave. Break the huddle.

visual.coach: Head coach off the lane with the tally. Count it out loud and break the huddle. Assistants collect balls and cones.

extras.title: Rim War
extras.note: 1v1 from the block, winner stays, first to 3 runs the Victory Lap.

extras.title: Knockout
extras.note: 2 balls. Free throw line, then elbow, then top of the key 3.
